quests.title: A Lady's Invitation

dialogue.t: Oh? You're here.
Hiya, Sandrone!

dialogue.sit: Hope we didn't keep you waiting.

dialogue.t: Huh? Didn't your letter say we were having a tea party? How come there's nothing here? Don't tell Paimon this is a snack-free get-together!?
Hah, I bet you would love that, Paimon? You really think I'd forget the food?
Whoa! Did... Did that table just appear out of thin air!?
Hehe, impressive, right? This is my newly developed portable tea table.
It's easy to carry and store, and even equipped with a hover device, just like Fagio.
What's even more impressive is... Oh, uhm, never mind, I don't want to show off and make this sound like a sales pitch. You can check it out for yourselves.
Here, I've prepared some tea and snacks.
Mmm...! These are so delicious! You really are a great cook!
Naturally.
But what inspired you to make something like this?
I wanted to be able to enjoy pleasant tea parties with friends wherever they are, of course.
I've said this before. Holding on to what you already have isn't the only way to preserve what's precious.
Lately, I've found myself wanting to go on walks and visit my friends more often.
But inviting myself to others' homes and expecting them to prepare tea and treats, then letting them clear the table afterward... It's hardly proper etiquette for a lady.
Hehe, Paimon doesn't think your friends would mind.
I mind. Besides, a simple invention like this is no trouble at all for me.
I can see you like it. Don't worry, I can make one for you, too.
Huh!? Are you sure that's alright?
It's perfectly fine. Like I told you, I can whip up something like this in no time.

dialogue.sit: In that case, thank you very much...

dialogue.t: Don't mention it. You helped me out a lot during the Fontinalia Festival. Consider this as thanks.

quests.description: You receive a tea party invitation letter from Sandrone…Note: It is recommended that you complete “Sunny Summer Fontinalia” for the best experience.
